text: A type A is n-truncated (has h-level ≤ n+2) iff:
choices: A has at most n elements
all identity types IdA(a,b) are (n-1)-truncated (i.e., h-level ≤ n+1)
explanation: Inductively: A is (-2)-truncated iff isContr; A is (-1)-truncated iff isProp; A is 0-truncated (a set) iff all a=b are props; A is n-truncated iff all a=b are (n-1)-truncated.
